main_text.p: tronos fecit: superstitiosum hoc genus: cui ne manifestus quidem Antiquitatis error sine sacrario est: Novitatum osores audiunt. His accedit Philosophorum vulgus, vecors illud cæcæ consuetudinis mancipium: hi communia, quotidiana, pervagata, quæ passim apud populum increbuêre, cuiusmodicumque illa sint,ferunt; Ea, quorum insolentes sunt, exibilant, explodunt, sarcasmis exagitant & dicteriis proscindunt. His freti patronis seductores, quem fraude sibi arrogarant, etiamnum fraude gerunt & administrant Ducatum, & porro seducunt impu-
main_text.notes: The left-margin fragments belong to the neighbouring page and were left out. The catchword "impu-" is at the right below the last full line. The word "osores" is printed in italic with a long s, read as "osores". The word "ductores" is printed with a ct ligature.
